```{r fitting}
# take a single subject's selection trials and their association matrix, and evaluate given selection strategy
eval_selection_strategy <- function(mat, selections, strategy) {
  # mat could be model-based association matrix 
  nlogLik = 0
  probOfSelections = rep(NA, nrow(selections))
  # 'learning progress' strat would consider how much entropy is reduced if each item is picked, and maximize
  for(i in 1:nrow(selections)) { # each selection trial
    if(strategy=="entropy") {
      selection_entropy = apply(mat, 2, shannon.entropy) # entropy of each referent's associates
      # vector of model-based (predicted) probabilities of choosing each referent on this selection trial
      predictedSelections = selection_entropy / sum(selection_entropy) # could do exponentiated Luce choice (softmax)
      # Model-based Prob of choosing referent that was actually selected:
      actual_selection_prob = as.numeric(predictedSelections[selections[i,]$choice_image]) 
    } else if(strategy=="random") {
      actual_selection_prob = 1/ncol(mat) # baseline: choose referent randomly G: should this be predictedSelections ??
    } else if(strategy=="margin") {
      # for each label, find two strongest associates; choose with probability proportional to minimal difference between those strengths
      predictedSelections = rep(NA, ncol(mat))
      for(o in 1:ncol(mat)) {
        top2 = sort(mat[,o], decreasing = T)[1:2]
        predictedSelections[o] = 1-(top2[1]-top2[2])
      }
      predictedSelections = predictedSelections / sum(predictedSelections) # this assumes probabilistic choice based on relative margin difference
      actual_selection_prob = as.numeric(predictedSelections[selections[i,]$choice_image]) 
    } else if(strategy=="confirmatory") {
      max_frequency = apply(mat, 2, max)
      predictedSelections = max_frequency / sum(max_frequency)
      actual_selection_prob = as.numeric(predictedSelections[selections[i,]$choice_image])
    } else if(strategy=="novelty") {
      ref_novelty = 1/apply(mat, 2, max) # inverse max frequency (problem if 0..)
      predictedSelections = ref_novelty / sum(ref_novelty)
      actual_selection_prob = as.numeric(predictedSelections[selections[i,]$choice_image])
    }
    other_selections_prob = 1-actual_selection_prob
    nlogLik = nlogLik - (log(actual_selection_prob) + log(other_selections_prob)) 
    probOfSelections[i] = actual_selection_prob
    # need to update co-occurrences!
    mat[selections[i,]$choice_label, selections[i,]$choice_image] = 
      mat[selections[i,]$choice_label, selections[i,]$choice_image] + 1
  }
  return(list(nlogLik = nlogLik, probOfSelections = probOfSelections, mat = mat))
}

# right now, this evaluates selection strategies - 
# want to jointly evaluate selection strategy + accuracy, given particular model (and parameters)

# iterates through participants, gets their model-based association matrix,
eval_selection_trials_group <- function(ords, xd, strategy) {
  total_logLik = 0
  for(s in names(ords)) {
    #testdat_s <- testdat |> filter(subject == s)
    #res <- model(parms, ord = ords[[s]], start_matrix = start_matrix)
    # test evaluation
    #mat <- res$matrix[testdat_s$target_label, testdat_s$target_image]
    #mod_perf <- diag(mat) / rowSums(mat)
    # s = "Crossact1_p101"
    mat <- create_cooc_matrix(ords[[s]]) # training co-occurrences - want to eventually use model association matrix
    
    # evaluate selection strategy
    sel <- eval_selection_strategy(mat, xd |> filter(subject==s, trial_type=="selection"), strategy=strategy)
    
    # matrix after selections 
    post_selection_mat <- sel$mat
    
    total_logLik <- total_logLik + sel$nlogLik
  }
  
  return(total_logLik)
}

fit_model_per_subject <- function(model_name, xd, lower, upper, par_priors=NULL) {
  source(paste0("R/",model_name,".R"))
  
  ords <- list()
  for(s in unique(xd$subject)) {
    ords[[s]] <- get_subject_trial_ordering(xd |> filter(subject==s))
  }
  
  # sapply across subjects, save best-fitting parameters, log-liks, and per-subj/-item predictions
  sfits <- tibble()
  fit_results <- tibble()
  for(s in names(ords)) { # s = "p621758"
    xd_s <- xd |> filter(subject==s)
    testdat <- xd_s |> filter(trial_type=="test", trial_index<37) # excludes 37-44; Experiment S1's post-sampling phase test trials
    fit <- DEoptim::DEoptim(eval_model, lower=lower, upper=upper, par_priors=par_priors,
                          DEoptim::DEoptim.control(reltol=.001, NP=100, itermax=100),
                          ord = ords[[s]], testdat=testdat, logLik_only=T, # SSE_only=T
                          start_matrix = crossact_mats[[xd_s$experiment_name[1]]]) 
    # re-eval best fit
    best_par <- fit$optim$bestmem
    new_fit <- tibble(subject = s, neg_log_lik = fit$optim$bestval, chi = best_par[1], lambda = best_par[2], alpha = best_par[3])
    print(new_fit)
    sfits <- sfits |> bind_rows(new_fit)
    best_result <- eval_model(best_par, testdat, ords[[s]], crossact_mats[[xd_s$experiment_name[1]]])
    fit_results <- fit_results |> bind_rows(best_result)
  }
  return(list(sfits=sfits, fit_results=fit_results))
}

# test function - for crossact, it's all-AFC for adults and kids; need to do 2AFC version for act exp
eval_model <- function(parms, testdat, ord, start_matrix, SSE_only=FALSE, logLik_only=FALSE, par_priors = NULL) {
  res <- model(parms, ord = ord, start_matrix = start_matrix)
  mat <- res$matrix[testdat$target_label, testdat$target_image] # reorder matrix by correct mapping
  mod_perf = tibble(target_label = rownames(mat), mod_perf = diag(mat) / rowSums(mat))
  mp <- testdat |> left_join(mod_perf, by="target_label") |>
    select(subject, experiment_name, age_group, age, trial_index, choice_label, target_image, target_label, is_right, mod_perf) 
  logLik_value = -sum(mp$is_right * log(mp$mod_perf) + (1-mp$is_right) * log(1-mp$mod_perf)) 
  if (!is.null(par_priors)) {
    penalty <- sum(.004*(parms - par_priors)^2) # weak Gaussian regularization (penalize deviation from priors)
    logLik_value <- logLik_value + penalty
  }
  if(SSE_only) return(sum((mp$is_right - mp$mod_perf)^2)) # minimize SSE
  if(logLik_only) return(logLik_value) # minimize negative log-lik
  return(mp)
}
```

```{r select-k, eval=F}
library(cluster)

param_df <- results |> ungroup() |>
  select(chi, lambda, alpha) |>
  scale()

wcss <- numeric(10)
for (k in 1:10) {
  set.seed(42) 
  kmeans_model <- kmeans(param_df, centers=k, nstart=10)
  wcss[k] <- kmeans_model$tot.withinss
}
plot(1:10, wcss, type="b", xlab="Number of clusters (k)", ylab="WCSS", 
     main="Elbow Method for Optimal k")
```

## Relationships between model parameters and performance

```{r}
library(lme4)

results_clean <- results |>
  filter(!is.na(age)) |>
  mutate(age_centered = scale(age, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE))

# Does chi predict performance above and beyond age?
m1 <- lmer(Human ~ age_centered + (1|experiment_name), data = results_clean)
m2 <- lmer(Human ~ age_centered + chi + (1|experiment_name), data = results_clean)
m3 <- lmer(Human ~ age_centered + chi + lambda + (1|experiment_name), data = results_clean)
m4 <- lmer(Human ~ age_centered + chi + lambda + alpha + (1|experiment_name), data = results_clean)

anova(m1, m2, m3, m4)
```

## Sampling behavior analysis

Need to extract relative entropy for each chosen referent on selection trials.

```{r}
# Extract sampling data
sampling_data <- xd |>
  filter(trial_type == "selection") |>
  left_join(results |> select(subject, chi, lambda, alpha, Human, age))

# Create ambiguity scores based on model predictions
# For each selection trial, calculate entropy of chosen vs. unchosen items

get_selection_ambiguity <- function(subject_id, selection_trial_idx, ords, parms) {
  #ord <- ords[[subject_id]]
  xd_s <- xd |> filter(subject == subject_id) # and experiment?
  ord <- get_subject_trial_ordering(xd_s)
  # Run model up to selection point
  res <- model(parms, ord = ord, iterations = selection_trial_idx - 1,
               start_matrix = crossact_mats[[xd |> filter(subject==subject_id) |>
                                              pull(experiment_name) |> first()]])
  
  # Calculate entropy for each available referent
  mat <- res$matrix
  entropies <- apply(mat, 2, shannon.entropy)
  
  # Get actual choice
  choice_img <- xd |> 
    filter(subject == subject_id, trial_index == selection_trial_idx) |>
    pull(choice_image)
  
  return(list(
    choice_entropy = entropies[choice_img],
    mean_entropy = mean(entropies),
    max_entropy = max(entropies),
    chose_max = choice_img == names(which.max(entropies))
  ))
}

# Apply to all subjects and selection trials
sampling_analysis <- sampling_data |>
  group_by(subject) |>
  mutate(selection_num = row_number()) |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(
    # This requires fitting - use best-fit params from ind_fits
    parms = list(ind_fits$sfits |> filter(subject == !!subject) |> 
                  select(chi, lambda, alpha) |> as.numeric())
  )
```

## Selection Strategy Evaluation

```{r}
# Evaluate each strategy for each age group
selection_strategies <- c("entropy", "confirmatory", "random", "novelty", "margin")

strategy_fits <- expand_grid(
  experiment = unique(xd$experiment_name),
  age_group = c("child", "adult"),
  strategy = selection_strategies
) |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(
    nlogLik = eval_selection_trials_group(
      ords |> keep(~{
        subj <- names(ords)[which(names(ords) == .x)]
        exp_match <- xd |> filter(subject == subj) |> 
          pull(experiment_name) |> first() == experiment
        age_match <- xd |> filter(subject == subj) |>
          pull(age_group) |> first() == age_group
        exp_match & age_match
      }),
      xd |> filter(experiment_name == experiment, age_group == age_group),
      strategy = strategy
    )
  )

# Visualize best-fitting strategies by age/experiment
strategy_fits |>
  ggplot(aes(x = age_group, y = -nlogLik, fill = strategy)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  facet_wrap(~experiment) +
  labs(title = "Selection strategy fits by age and experiment",
       y = "Log Likelihood") +
  theme_classic()
```
